Trace, implement and test: leetcode869 reordered power of 2 convert to string with hashmap

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<unordered_map>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    bool reorderedPowerOf2(int n) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= 1e9; i *= 2)
        {
            if (canOrderToSame(i, n)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    bool canOrderToSame(int i, int n) /* 判断整数i是否重新排序后能和n相等 */
    {
        unordered_map<char, int> dict1, dict2;
        for (auto ch : to_string(i)) dict1[ch]++; /* 转为字符串, 统计其中每一个字符出现的次数 */
        for (auto ch : to_string(n)) dict2[ch]++;
        return dict1 == dict2;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int n = 24;
    auto res = sol.reorderedPowerOf2(n);
    cout << (res ? "True" : "False") << endl;

    return 0;
}
